messages:
Priya (Marketing): Need a tight battlecard for the July webinar focus: benchmark headlines vs managed cloud endpoints + 3 SDR snips + procurement rebut bullets.

Jordan (Product): Core claims: unified runtime across hosted/ded/private; cost controls via batching & KV cache; graceful fallbacks with model routing.

Mateo (Eng-ML): Quick bench snapshot: redwood-v1 quant vs CloudX-managed on chat workload -> ~30% lower cost_per_1k after batching; ~25ms p95 improvement. Will upload CSV link.

Sam (Sales): SDR lines, short:
- Cost: "Reduce per-token spend with batching and cache."
- Latency: "Consistent p95s engineered for production."
- Security: "Private control plane + KMS for compliant deploys."

Lila (Growth): Webinar headlines to test: "Predictable inference, predictable costs." and "Ship LLM features without surprise bills." Ill run the A/B.

Ava (Field): Procurement rebut bullets: 1) Convenience vs control: managed endpoints are easy, Redwood is a serving runtime with private VPC and rollout tooling. 2) Measurable levers: batching, cache, quant profiles to tune unit economics.

Jordan (Product): Add a tiny demo script to the battlecard: show region fallback -> compatible quantized model -> degraded-mode with prefix cache. Helps the field.

launch-bot: Reminder: Battlecard draft due 2026-07-12 16:00 UTC.

Priya (Marketing): Owners: Jordan add demo blurb; Mateo attach final numbers; Lila run headline AB; Sam finalize SDR playbook; Ava prepare 2-slide live demo. Ill assemble and circulate EOD Friday.
